svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Languages: Swift, Python, TypeScript, Objective-C, SQL. Apple platforms: SwiftUI, UIKit, Liquid Glass, WidgetKit, ActivityKit, MenuBarExtra. Backend: FastAPI and Vapor. Web: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Testing: Playwright, Vitest, axe-core, XCTest. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite. Swift tooling: SwiftSyntax, ArgumentParser, XcodeGen. Ship: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Homebrew.

g.text: Native apps in Swift for every Apple device
APIs and services in Python and Swift
Static analysis, CLIs and project generation
